feed.subtitle: Release notes, product stories and lessons from building apps for Apple TV and iPhone.

entry.title: Capybara Rush 1.5: daily runs, the Capybara Cup and a poster of your best run
entry.summary: What's new in Capybara Rush 1.5 for iPhone: a daily Game Center run from 21 October, the four-week Capybara Cup from 11 November, a poster of your run to share, and six Game Center achievements.

entry.title: Wi-Fi QR 1.7: guest signs that fit, WPA or WEP, and smarter sticker scans
entry.summary: What's new in Wi-Fi QR 1.7 for iPhone: WPA or WEP security with clear checks, printable guest Wi-Fi signs that fit long passwords on every paper size, and better router-sticker scanning, including Arabic labels.

entry.title: The best Quran apps for Apple TV, compared (2026)
entry.summary: An honest comparison of the Quran apps that run on Apple TV in 2026, about the TV experience only: listening, the Quran text, live streams, prayer times, Top Shelf, ads and price, with a source for every row. The author makes Sajdah, one of the apps compared.

entry.title: Sajdah 1.5.0: Live tab, Quran fonts and word-by-word recitation
entry.summary: What's new in Sajdah 1.5.0 for Apple TV: one Live tab for Quran radio and live TV, six Quran fonts, word-by-word recitation tracking, a calmer player and Top Shelf.

entry.title: The journey so far: building Sajdah for Apple TV
entry.summary: How Sajdah grew from a Quran player for the TV into a daily companion for Muslim homes on Apple TV: the origin, the design pivots, the lessons, and what comes next.
